reason: I'm only in Waikiki for a week and there are plenty of places to eat within walking distance of my hotel. Taking a taxi 10 minutes to Kapiolani for an $18.95 bowl of cold noodles, plus tax and tip, isn't worth it when nothing tells me about parking or the wait.
objection: It's out of my way, nothing says there's parking or how long the wait is, and $18.95 plus tax and tip for cold noodles is a lot when I can get good noodles cheaply back home in Japan.
would_change_my_mind: If I were already at Ala Moana Center shopping and saw it was a short walk with no wait, I'd probably stop in for lunch.
